scope: Nix coreutils 9.11 utility code. External implementations are contracts; no runtime closure. Entry-rooted and callback-inclusive measurements remain separate.
remaining_analysis_limits: Case matching verifies constructor/domain/alias/encoding applicability; AU templates were not instantiated by this matcher.
Family fuzz disagreements are adapter investigation context, not case verdicts or evidence against AU.
Static indirect control-flow targets and callback registration are not proved exhaustive.
Bootstrap mnemonic supply is conditional on exact-form generalization and guest-state projection; no emulator-derived models were acquired.
Handler-body mode requires justification of every exit boundary and overapproximates all function members; executable mode follows known internal edges and retains unresolved transfers.
Residual cycles combine alternatives; a cycle alone does not prove every implementation is blocked.
Bootstrap initial seeds include generalized_recipe only. Direct encodings, including retained NOP models, need relocation/reuse handling; their exclusion is not a claim of missing instruction theory.
